findings.summary: wiki_ingest_plan and wiki_ingest_apply do not form a usable pair, so spec §3's batch-ingest contract is unimplemented. wiki_ingest_plan(sources: str) merely runs one similarity search over sources[:200] and returns {candidates, base_sha}; it never enumerates the pages to import nor emits the required per-candidate '判重（对每个候选给出 create-vs-已存在近似页）' decision. wiki_ingest_apply then requires plan['pages'], a key wiki_ingest_plan can never produce, so the plan returned by the server cannot be applied. The suite hides this by hand-constructing a synthetic plan dict in test_ingest_apply instead of round-tripping plan output into apply.

Ingest-grade provenance still contradicts spec §2 for half the type enum. §2 states provenance is satisfied by '正文须含 # References 节或 frontmatter sources 非空（二者其一）' with no dependence on 类型, yet check_provenance hard-requires frontmatter sources whenever 类型 ∈ {源码分析, 架构} and rejects with '{page_type} 硬要求 frontmatter sources'. A compliant 源码分析/架构 page whose provenance is a # References section is refused by wiki_create and wiki_ingest_apply. This is the same defect class the prior final review blocked for 卡片/索引; only the non-code branch was fixed.

wiki_create's uniqueness check is outside the single write lock, so INV-2 ('标题任意时刻全库唯一') is defeated by concurrency. _validate_create_page — including the find_page_by_title TITLE_EXISTS gate — runs before _mutate acquires self._lock; two concurrent wiki_create calls for the same title both observe 'absent', then serialize, and the second _write silently overwrites the first page file, losing a committed page and reissuing a second id for the same title. The A8 test only exercises five distinct titles, so the race is never probed.

WikiSearch.remove_page only clears the keyword index; the lancedb vector row is never deleted, and _embed_page appends unconditionally. Every wiki_update/wiki_edit therefore accumulates duplicate vector rows for the same id, and deleted pages keep stale vectors forever. wiki_search masks the symptom by dropping ids whose page file no longer resolves, but the vector table grows monotonically and re-ranks against superseded page content.

_check_page_accessible only rejects pages whose parse raised (page['_error']). A pages/ file with no frontmatter delimiter at all parses cleanly to ({}, text) with id None, so wiki_get/wiki_read/wiki_update/wiki_edit/wiki_rename/wiki_delete treat it as a normal page and return or write id: null. INV-6 requires operations targeting an unparseable page to error out rather than proceed; the A6 test only asserts the TITLE_EXISTS path for such a file.
